issues.description: Bitmap24 constructor declaration is inconsistent between template and solution/implementation. The template header declares `Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height, int depth)`, but the implementation file defines `Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height)` and the solution header declares `Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height)`. Students including the template header may attempt to call or implement the 3-parameter constructor, leading to compile/link errors and API confusion.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor API consistent across template and solution. Recommended: change the template header declaration to `Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height);` to match the existing implementation and solution. Alternatively, if `depth` is intended, add and implement a matching 3-argument constructor in both repositories and update call sites accordingly.
